tickets.title: Refresh estate documents to include child guardian nomination
tickets.text: Refresh Mira and Jonas Quillwhistle's 2019 wills, powers of attorney, and health care directives to add a guardian nomination for Lila Quillwhistle, trust provisions for a minor child, and updated fiduciary choices. The 2019 documents predate parenthood and currently name Mira's sister Tessa Willowdoodle as backup decision maker without a child guardian.

The goal is to fund about half of a public university cost while preserving flexibility if Lila chooses another path.
